tei:div.tei:p: "Z "!#༄༅// bka' brgyad gsang ba yongs rdzogs kyi phrin las byang bu 'jug bder bkod pa mchog gsang grub pa'i bde lam zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

bla ma dpal chen sgrub pa sde brgyad kyi lha la phyag 'tshal lo// dkyil 'khor gcig tu rgyal kun gsang ba rdzogs// bsgom pas grub ster 'brel tshad thar par sbyor// klong dgu'i dkyil 'khor lha dang khyab bdag tu// gdod nas grub pa thod phreng rtsal la 'dud// grub brnyes rig 'dzin bye ba gshegs pa'i lam// sras bcas rgyal ba'i thugs kyi thig le mchog /gnas gsum mkha' 'gro'i gces pa'i dbyig mchog 'dir// 'jug bde'i khrigs su bsdeb la gnang ba stsol// de'ang 'di nyid kyi dkyil 'khor chen por dbang gis rgyud smin cing dam tshig gi srog rtsa brtan pa'i sgrub pa po dngos grub don du gnyer bas/ mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i gnas su dam tshig gi bris sku sogs rten bkram pa'i mdun du stegs bu gtsang mar dkyil 'khor ba dang bka' srung gi mchod gtor sman raka phyi mchod sogs phyag len ltar bkod/ nyer mkho'i yo byad rnams kyang tshogs par byas nas/ phrin las dngos la gsum/ sngon 'gro /dngos gzhi/ rjes kyi las rim mo// dang po la gnyis/ spyi dang bye brag go /dang po cho ga spyi'i yan lag dang mthun par skyabs sems ni/ trāṃ rat+na maṇ+ḍa la/ paṃ pad+ma maṇ+ḍa la/ ma sūr+ya maṇ+ḍa la/ a tsan+d+ra maṇ+ḍa la/ mdun gyi nam mkhar rin po che'i khri pad nyi zla ba'i gdan rnams gsal bar gyur/ rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas bla ma rig 'dzin dpal chen gtso dgu'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ bla ma sangs rgyas 'khor dang bcas: kun nas bdag la dgongs su gsol: bla ma dkon mchog rnam gsum la: byang chub ma thob bar du ni: skyabs kyi mchog tu bzung bar bgyi: sngon nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib bshags: 'gro don sangs rgyas 'thob bya'i phyir: smon pa'i byang chub sems ni bskyed: sems can yongs su smin bya'i phyir: gsang sngags spyod pa rlabs chen spyad: don dam spros bral byang chub sems:

rang byung mtha' bral stong gsal bsgom: lan gsum/ rgyun bshags yan lag brgyad pas tshogs gsag pa ni/ rdo rje slob dpon sangs rgyas dpal// sogs bya/ sems can bde dang ldan gyur cig /sdug bsngal kun dang bral bar shog /bde dang rtag tu mi 'bral zhing*// chos kun mnyam nyid rtogs par shog /dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ tshogs zhing rnams rang la thim par gyur/ 'byung gtor gtang ba ni/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i snod zab cing rgya che ba'i nang du khaṃ las glud gtor 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gsum/ sarba bhūta ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ sa mgron 'gugs/ a kā ro gsum gyis bsngo/ hūm̐: yang dag don la mi mos shing: mi dang mi min log 'dren bgegs: lan chags re gtor 'di khyer la: gnas 'di khor yug tshun chad du: skad cig tsam yang 'da' ma byed: gal te nga yi bka' 'das na: bde gshegs mkha' 'gro kun 'dus nas: lus ngag rdul phran bzhin du rlog: ces bgegs gtor phyir dor ro// gnyis pa bye brag gter gzhung gi rtsis 'gos bsdus pa sngon 'gro'i las bdun du gsungs pa'i dang po mtshams bcad pa la/ thog mar bka' bsgo ba ni/ stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis bdag nyid dpal chen gtso dgu me 'bar ba'i klong na bzhugs pa'i sku las sprul pa yang sprul gyi khro tshogs skar ltar 'khrugs pas bgegs thams cad rgyang ring du bskrad par gyur/ hūm̐: rgyal ba zhi khro yongs rdzogs dkyil 'khor du: snang srid rnam dag ye shes lha yi tshogs: kun bzang chos kyi dbyings las ma g.yos kyang: rig rtsal rnam dag thabs shes g.yung drung lha: 'di la log par lta ba'i dgra dang bgegs: bdud sde dpung bcas thams cad phyir dengs shig: oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hūm̐: gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa hūm̐: gṛh+ṇā pa ya gṛh+ṇā pa ya hūm̐: ā na ya ho: bha ga bān bid+ya rā dza hūm̐ phaṭa: mtshon cha me phung gi mtshams ni/

hūm̐: bdag nyid dpal chen khrag 'thung thugs ka nas: drag po'i byin rlabs mtshon cha'i 'od zer 'phro: mtshon cha'i gur chen ye shes me phung 'bar: phyogs mtshams steng 'og kun tu khyab par srungs: hūm̐ badz+ra tsakra tīk+ṣa karma kī la ya dz+wa la raṃ: khro bo rol pa'i mtshams ni/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las khro bo ṭāk+ki rā dza mthing nag tho ba dang zhags pa 'dzin pa grangs med spros/ phyogs skyong bcu bkug ste phyogs bcur bsnol ba'i steng du hūm̐ yig rnams spros pa khro bo'i tshogs su gyur pas srung ba'i phrin las mdzad par gyur/ hūm̐: dregs pa lha chen phyogs skyong bsnol ba'i steng: che mchog la sogs dpal chen khro rgyal tshogs: gar dgu'i tshul gyis hūm̐ sgra sgrog cing bzhugs: bar chad 'byung po thams cad rdul du rlog: oṃ badz+ra kro dha swa bhā ba sa ma ya ru lu ru lu hūm̐ phaṭa: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ bi shwa badz+ra tsakra dz+wa la maṇ+ḍa la ha la ha la hūm̐ phaṭa: gnyis pa brda sgo dbye ba ni/ snod bcud gdod nas gzhal yas khang dang lha'i rang bzhin du shes pas/ hūm̐: snang srid thams cad bde chen gzhal yas khang: gzugs snang thams cad rang rig ye shes lha: de nyid ma rtogs ma rig sgo bcad pas: rang gsal ye shes 'char sgo da phyes shig: bh+rūm̐ pra be sha ya phaṭa: gsum pa brda phyag 'tshal ba ni/ de dag rang sems las gzhan du ma grub par shes pas/ hūm̐: rang byung ye shes snying po sems kyi lha: ma rtogs rang ngo rang gis ma shes pas: ye nas rang dang 'grogs kyang zhal ma mjal: rang gsal brda yis don dang mjal phyag 'tshal: hūm̐ he ru ka a ti pū ho: pra tīts+tsha ho: bzhi pa dam bca' ba ni/ de ltar rtogs pa las nam yang mi 'da' ba'i blos/ hūm̐: dus gsum bde gshegs rgyal ba zhi khro'i tshogs: bskal pa sngon 'das dus nas yi dam lha: da lta gnyis med don dam rang ngo shes: srog gi phyir yang mi gtang bsgrub lags so: hūm̐ badz+ra tsit+ta sa ma ya hūm̐:

lnga pa byin dbab pa ni/ thugs srog 'od zer gyis bskul bas rgyal ba thams cad sgrub chen yongs rdzogs kyi rnam par byon nas bdag gnas yo byad rnams la thim pas snod bcud ye shes kyi 'khor lor gyur par mos la dbyangs rol sbyar spos kyis mtshon par/ hūm̐: chos dbyings ye shes lnga yi pho brang nas: chos sku skye med dbyings las ma g.yos kyang: longs sku rigs lnga zhi khro 'khor dang bcas: sprul sku yi dam dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams: thugs dam dbang gis gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: sku gsung thugs kyi byin gyis brlab tu gsol: ye shes lnga yi dbang mchog bskur du gsol: gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'di la byin zhig phob: khyed kyi thugs rje mchog gis bzung du gsol: oṃ shrī badz+ra kro dha he ba de ba sarba duṣ+ṭāṃ ḍā ki nī sa ma ya ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐ ā be sha ya a ā: skabs 'dir chos dbang yab sras kyi phyag bzhes su tshig bdun gsol 'debs kyis byin dbab par yang bshad do// drug pa mchod rdzas byin brlab pa ni/ mchod bya mchod byed gnyis med du shes pas/ hūm̐: rang dang gnyis med lha tshogs la: mar me sman gtor rak+ta dang: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin rnams: thugs dam bskang phyir 'bul gyis bzhes: zhes dang*/ so sor brlab pa ni/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ/ rang gi thugs ka nas raṃ yaṃ khaṃ 'phros pa ye shes kyi me rlung chur gyur pas mchod rdzas rnams kyi dngos 'dzin nyes skyon thams cad bsreg gtor bkrus te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams su bdug spos me tog mar me dri chab zhal zas rol mo thogs pa'i lha mo re re la'ang dpag tu med par 'phro ba'i kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin phung nam mkha' mdzod lta bur zad mi shes pas khyab par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra dhū pe hūm̐: badz+ra puṣ+pe hūm̐: badz+ra ā lo ke hūm̐:

badz+ra gan+dhe hūm̐: badz+ra nai bid+ya hūm̐: badz+ra shab+da hūm̐: badz+ra sarba pū dza me gha hūm̐: bdud rtsi la/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung*/ raṃ las me/ kaṃ las thod pa'i sgyed pu gsum gyi steng du āḥlas ban+dha yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi pa'i lte ba dang rtsibs rnams la sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga sman lnga rnams gnas pa la/ rlung gis me sbar te zhu ba yongs su gyur pa las phyag mtshan bcu so so'i lte bar hūm̐ oṃ swā aṃ hā mūṃ lāṃ māṃ pāṃ tāṃ gyis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros/ 'khor 'das kyi bcud thams cad bsdus te thim pa yongs su gyur pa las rigs lnga yab yum lngar gyur pa'i sbyor mtshams nas byang chub kyi sems dkar dmar gyi rgyun babs pa'i steng du rigs lnga yab yum 'od du zhu nas thim pas bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛta hūm̐ hrīḥṭha: lan gsum/ gtor ma la/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las thod pa dum bu gcig pa stong gsum dang mnyam pa'i nang du/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha'i zhal zas 'dod yon lnga'i lha mo sprin gyi phung po lta bur 'khrigs par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā ba liṃ ta te dzo ba liṃ ta ba la ba te gu h+ya sa ma ye swā hā: lan gsum/ rak+ta la/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma 'bar ba'i snod chen por/ ra las rdo rje sgeg mo dmar mo'i mkha' nas khrag babs te/ nyon mongs pa bag chags dang bcas pa 'joms pa'i rak+ta'i rgya mtsho rba klong rgya mdud kyi tshul du 'khrugs pa la lha mo nyid 'od du zhu nas thim pas 'khor ba stongs par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā rak+ta sa man+ta maṇ+ḍa la hūm̐ phaṭa: lan gsum/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza: ma hā pañtsa: ma hā ba liṃ ta: ma hā rak+ta: a ho su kha sa ma ye swā hā: zhes mchod rdzas spyir byin gyis brlab bo// bdun pa bshags pa ni/ rtsa gsum lha tshogs nam mkha' gang bar bzhugs pa la nyes ltung snying nas bshags pas nyams chag rtog sgrib gzhi med du dag par

mos la/ hūm̐: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro thams cad dgongs: bskal pa sngon nas da lta'i dus yan chad: rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig nyams chag sogs: rang gnong 'gyod sems drag pos mthol zhing bshags: oṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā: badz+ra sa ma ya dza: na ra ka: pre ta ka: tīr+ya ka: ni bi sha: de ba a li bi shud+dhe: dak+ṣa ka shud+dhe shud+dhe swā hā: 'dir spro na 'di nyid kyi gzhung las 'byung ba/ bde gshegs rgyal ba sogs sam/ ye shes sku mchog brjod par bya'o// spyi don gnyis pa dngos gzhi la las rim nyer lngar gsungs pa'i dang po ting 'dzin rnam gsum ni/ de ting chos thams cad gdod nas spros pa dang bral ba'i gnas lugs la mnyam par bzhag ste/ hūm̐: spros med yang dag de bzhin nyid: mnyam yangs phyogs bral kun tu gdal: ma nor ma bcos chos kyi sku: rang bzhin lhun grub ngang gis gsal: oṃ ma hā shūn+ya tā dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā ba āt+ma ko3 haṃ: kun snang rang bzhin de nyid ma rtogs pa'i sems can rnams la snying rje phyogs med du brdal bas/ hūm̐: de bzhin kun khyab kun tu snang: ma rig 'khrul snang 'khor ba'i klong: gzung 'dzin bag chags rab tu 'thas: ma rtogs sems can snying re rje: oṃ dharma dhā tu swa bhā ba bi shud+dhe maṇ+ḍa la hūm̐: rgyu ting stong nyid snying rje zung 'jug gi rang rtsal hūm̐ mthing sngon nam mkha' la zla ba lding ba ltar gnas par bsams la/ hūm̐: chos rnams rang byung rten 'brel te: rgyu las ma byung gang yang med: hūm̐ ni thams cad bskyed pa'i rgyu: dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i yi ge bsgom: tsit+ta badz+ra sa mā ti hūm̐: gnyis pa 'byung rim ni/ rgyu yi yi ge hūm̐ sngon las: raṃ yaṃ khaṃ gsum rim bzhin 'phros: hūm̐: bskal pa gsum gyis 'jig rten stong: ye nas dag pa'i ngang nyid las: snod bcud sbyang phyir 'byung rim brtsegs: rnam dag yum lnga'i mkha' klong gsal: hūm̐ e yaṃ ra suṃ keṃ raṃ bh+rūm̐:

hūm̐: e las nam mkha' mtha' dbus med: yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor steng: ra las rak+ta'i rgya mtsho 'khyil: suṃ las zhing chen sa gzhi brdal: keṃ las rus pa'i ri rab steng: raṃ las bskal pa'i me dpung 'bar: gsum pa gzhal yas khang bskyed pa ni/ hūm̐: bh+rūm̐ las rin chen gzhal yas khang: dur khrod rab 'jigs dkyil 'khor bskyed: zla gam ye shes 'char sgo'i dbus: chos sku 'gyur med e ru gsal: bhan+dha skam rlon pho brang brtsigs: rin chen mdzes pa'i dkyil 'khor dgu: 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi mu khyud bcas: gru chad bar khyams sgo khyud rdzogs: rang byung lhun grub ngo mtshar che: dregs pa pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan: gtso dang 'khor la 'tsham par gsal: bh+rūm̐ bi shwa bi shud+dhe bhañdza dzñā na e tsakra maṇ+ḍa la bh+rūm̐: ru dra kro dhi ti ra baṃ: ma sūr+ya maṇ+ḍa la: a tsan+d+ra maṇ+ḍa la: paṃ pad+ma maṇ+ḍa la: bzhi pa lha bskyed pa ni/ hūm̐: rgyu yi yi ge gdan la babs: spro bsdu'i sbyor bas dpal chen sku: bdag nyid che mchog he ru ka: mthing nag zhal gsum phyag drug pa: zhabs bzhi gyad kyi dor stabs bgrad: g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus mthing zhal: rigs lngas dbu brgyan thugs srog hūm̐: spyan dgu zhal bgrad mche ba gtsigs: g.yas kyi phyag gsum rdo rje gsor: g.yon gyi phyag gsum bhan dmar 'dzin: dur khrod 'jigs pa'i chas kyis brgyan: gnam zhal yum chen kun bzang 'khril: zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog mthing: g.yas pas gtsor 'khyud kha ṭ+wāṃ bsnams: g.yon pa dung dmar gtso la stob: mkha' gsang byin rlabs ni/ ma sūr+ya maṇ+ḍa la: hūm̐ badz+ra oṃ: a tsan+d+ra maṇ+ḍa la: e aṃ: sa ma ya ho: sa ma ya s+t+waṃ: ra ho haṃ: rā ga yā mi: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: sa ma ya mu dra: pra be sha ya phaṭa: oṃ oṃ oṃ: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa: s+pha ra ṇa phaṭa: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: yab yum sbyor ba'i byin rlabs las: rigs bzhi la sogs 'khor bcas gsal: bskal pa'i me dpung klong na bzhugs:

oṃ badz+ra kro dha ma hā shrī he ru ka hūm̐ phaṭa: ma hā kro dhī shwa ri s+t+waṃ: hūm̐: dpal chen yab yum thugs ka nas: phyogs bzhi mtshams bzhi'i dkyil 'khor du: mthing nag hūm̐ chen yig 'bru spro: khrag 'thung yab yum sras bcas bskyed: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐: shar du badz+ra he ru ka: badz+ra kro dhī shwa rī yum: rigs bzhi la sogs 'khor bcas gsal: oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐ phaṭa: hūm̐: lho ru 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed: za byed bai tā nag mo yum: rigs bzhi la sogs 'khor bcas gsal: oṃ a kro te ka ya mān+ta ka ha na ma tha bhañdza hūm̐ phaṭa: hūm̐: nub tu dbang chen rta mchog dpal: pad+ma gzi ldan khro mo yum: rigs bzhi la sogs 'khor bcas gsal: oṃ pad+mān+ta kṛta ma hā kro dha h+ya grī ba hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa: hūm̐: byang du rdo rje gzhon nu che: 'khor lo rgyas 'debs dpal gyi yum: rigs bzhi la sogs 'khor bcas gsal: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nān baṃ hūm̐ phaṭa: hūm̐: shar lhor bla med he ru ka: nyid bzhi bde mchog chen mo yum: ma lnga la sogs 'khor bcas gsal: oṃ gu h+ya dzñā na shrī he ru ka gu h+ya dzñā na kro dhī shwa rī s+t+waṃ ma ma yo gi ni ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐ phaṭa: hūm̐: lho nub rig 'dzin thod pa rtsal: rdo rje rnal 'byor gsang ba'i yum: rigs bzhi la sogs 'khor bcas gsal: oṃ badz+ra ma hā gu ru sarba hūm̐ phaṭa: hūm̐: nub byang dregs pa kun 'dul dpal: khams gsum srid pa spyi 'dul yum: rigs bzhi la sogs 'khor bcas gsal: oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa sarba duṣ+ṭān hūm̐ phaṭa: hūm̐: byang shar stobs ldan nag po che: 'byung ba lnga yi bdag mo yum: rigs bzhi la sogs 'khor bcas gsal: oṃ badz+ra sarba duṣ+ṭāṃ e dza bh+yo hūm̐ phaṭa: hūm̐: nyi ma dang ni 'od zer bzhin: dpal chen so so'i sprul 'khor bcas:

phyi rol sgo ba rigs bzhi ni: ya mān pradzñān pad+mān big: lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril: tshom bu dgu yi lha tshogs rnams: sku mdog phyag mtshan rgyan cha lugs: ma 'dres yongs su rdzogs par gsal: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: hūm̐: phyi rol lcags ri khor yug la: mkha' 'gro dbang phyug ging laṅka: 'bar ma ma sring bka' sdod tshogs: bsam gyis mi khyab yongs rdzogs gtibs: ma hā mu dra sa ma ya ho:

lnga pa byin brlab pa ni/ hūm̐: rang byung dkyil 'khor dpal chen tshogs: mthu rtsal yongs su rdzogs bya'i phyir: sku gsung thugs su byin rlobs la: ye shes rnam lngas dbang skur cig: lha tshogs rnams kyi dpral bar 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa'i lte bar rnam snang dkar po thugs kar oṃ gyis mtshan pa/ ljags pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi lte bar snang ba mtha' yas dmar po thugs kar āḥs mtshan pa/ thugs rdo rje rgya gram gyi lte bar rdo rje sems dpa' mthing kha thugs kar hūm̐ gis mtshan pas dus gsum bde gshegs bla ma rig 'dzin thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs yongs su rdzogs pa thob/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: drug pa dbang bskur ba ni/ spyi bo'i gnas lngar dpa' bo 'bru lnga las rgyal ba rigs lnga sogs zhi ba bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis kyi lha tshogs rnams bzhugs nas dbang chen rab 'byams kyi dbang bskur ba thob ste 'gro don la dpa' bar gyur/ oṃ hūm̐ swā hrīḥhā: oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta kā ya wa k+tsit+ta dzñā na pañtsa badz+ra swa bhā ba āt+ma ko3 haṃ: bdun pa spyan drang ba ni/ lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas ye shes sems dpa'i thugs rgyud bskul/ chos kyi sku las gzugs sku dpal chen gtso dgu'i lha tshogs su bzhengs nas byon par gyur/ hūm̐: rnam dag chos dbyings mnyam nyid las: zhi khro yongs rdzogs sku bzhengs la: srid gsum gdug pa'i tshogs bsgral phyir: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: oṃ e h+ye hi sa ma ya dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥhriṃ hriṃ dza: brgyad pa brtan bzhugs ni/ dam ye gnyis med du thim par mos la/ hūm̐: bde gshegs kun 'dus dkyil 'khor 'dir: dam tshig ye shes dbyer med par: chu la chu bzhag ji bzhin du: du ma ro gcig brtan par bzhugs: sa ma ya ā be sha ya tiṣ+ṭha s+t+waṃ: dgu pa phyag 'tshal ba ni/ rang gi thugs ka nas lha mo bsam gyis mi khyab pa sprul pa rnams kyis phyag mchod bstod pas bsnyen bkur bar

mos la/ hūm̐: chos rnams rang bzhin ye nas dag: rtog 'khrul 'jig rten sems can la: sku gsung thugs yon phrin las ston: dkyil 'khor lha la phyag 'tshal lo: a ti pū ho: na maḥhriṃ: bcu pa phyag rgya gar mchod ni/ hūm̐: gdul bya'i mos blo tha dad pas: zhi dang khro dang 'dres pa'i tshul: sku mdog zhal phyag bsam 'das kyang: lha rnams gsal 'debs gar mchod 'bul: hūm̐: dpal chen che mchog he ru ka: dbu gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bgrad: g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus mthing zhal: rigs lngas dbu brgyan thugs srog gsal: g.yas kyi phyag gsum rdo rje gdengs: g.yon gyi phyag gsum bhan dmar 'dzin: yum chen gnam zhal kun bzang 'khril: g.yas pas gtsor 'khyud kha ṭ+wāṃ ga: g.yon pa chags pa'i dung dmar stob: yab yum thabs shes zung 'jug rgya: phyag rgya gar gyi mchod pa bzhes: hūm̐: dpal chen badz+ra he ru ka: dbu gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bgrad: g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus mthing zhal: rigs lngas dbu brgyan thugs srog gsal: g.yas gsum rtse dgu kha ṭ+wāṃ rnga: g.yon gsum dril bhan rgyu zhags bsnams: yum chen kro dhī shwa rī ma: g.yas pas gtsor 'khyud kha ṭ+wāṃ ga: g.yon pa chags pa'i dung dmar stob: yab yum thabs shes zung 'jug rgya: phyag rgya gar gyi mchod pa bzhes: hūm̐: dpal chen 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed: dbu gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bgrad: g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus mthing zhal: rigs lngas dbu brgyan thugs srog gsal: g.yas gsum be con ral gri s+t+wa: g.yon gsum sdigs mdzub mdung bhan dmar: yum chen badz+ra bai tā li: g.yas pas gtsor 'khyud kha ṭ+wāṃ ga: g.yon pa chags pa'i dung dmar stob: yab yum thabs shes zung 'jug rgya: phyag rgya gar gyi mchod pa bzhes: hūm̐: dpal chen rta mgrin pad+ma dbang: dbu gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bgrad: g.yas dkar g.yon sngo dbus dmar zhal: dbu gtsug rta skad phyogs bcur sgrog: rigs lngas dbu brgyan thugs srog gsal:

yab yum thabs shes zung 'jug rgya: phyag rgya gar gyi mchod pa bzhes: hūm̐: dpal chen stobs ldan nag po che: dbu gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bgrad: sku mdog mthing nag 'jigs pa la: rigs lngas dbu brgyan thugs srog gsal: g.yas gsum rdo rje lha brgyad snying: g.yon gsum bhan dmar klu brgyad snying: yum chen 'byung ba lnga yi bdag: g.yas pas gzugs khams mkha' la 'degs: g.yon pas 'dod khams sa la gnon: yab yum thabs shes zung 'jug rgya: phyag rgya gar gyi mchod pa bzhes: hūm̐: so so'i rigs bzhi 'khor tshogs rnams: zhal dang phyag mtshan cir yang bsgyur: bde gshegs thams cad gar gyi bdag: phyag rgya gar gyi mchod pa bzhes: ma hā mu dra pū dza ho: bcu gcig pa glu mchod ni/ hūm̐: stong pa'i rang bzhin cir yang snang: snang ba'i mtshan nyid skye ba med: glu ni 'du 'bral med pa'i glu: bro ni bar chad med par brdung: oṃ ma hā dzñā na te na hūm̐ te na te te hūm̐: bcu gnyis pa phyi mchod ni/ hūm̐: rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor du: bdug spos me tog mar me dri: zhal zas sil snyan mchod pa'i sprin: dbyings nas bton te dbyings su 'bul: oṃ pa na peṃ: pe nu su ra to: ti pu pa ra mu: sarba ta thā ga ta sid+dhi sa ma ya hoḥ oṃ shrī badz+ra rā ga dhū pe hūm̐: puṣ+pe trāṃ: ā lo ke hūm̐: gan+dhe hrī: nai bid+ya ā: gī ti shab+da hūm̐: bcu gsum pa nang mchod ni/ oṃ: mchod pa'i phyag rgya chen po ni: sems kyi yid bzhin sprin tshogs gtibs: gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya chos: 'dod yon lnga ldan mchod par bzhes: oṃ sarba pū dza sa ma ya ho: bcu bzhi pa gsang mchod ni/ hūm̐: 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug che: nga rgyal phrag dog nyon mongs lnga: ye nas rigs lnga'i rang bzhin yin: sbyor sgrol ting 'dzin dam mchod bzhes: ha la pañtsa pū dza ho: bco lnga pa dug gsum mchod pa ni/ hūm̐: sha khrag rus pa rnam pa gsum:

dug gsum mchod pa bla na med: ye nas sku gsum rang bzhin te: rang grol nyid du mchod par bzhes: ma hā māṃ sa: ma hā rak+ta: ma hā kiṃ ni ri ti khā hi: bcu drug pa sman mchod ni/ hūm̐: rang byung gdod nas rnam par dag: rtsa brgyad stong las sbyar ba'i sman: rigs lnga dam tshig lnga yi dngos: ye shes lnga rdzogs grub pa'i rdzas: rgyud lnga sems can kun bsgral phyir: dug lnga sel ba'i bdud rtsi che: oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛta hūm̐ hrīḥṭha: hūm̐: rtsa brgyad yan lag stong sbyar ba'i: thun mong mchog dang khyad 'phags 'di: dus gsum bla ma yi dam lha: rgyal ba zhi khro'i lha tshogs la: rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul: thugs rjes brtser dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛta kha raṃ khā hi: hrī: dam skong dbang dang shes rgyud lung ston pa'i: nges pa'i don ston rtsa brgyud bla ma la: rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul: thugs rjes brtser dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛta kha raṃ khā hi: bde gshegs zhi ba che mchog gshin rje'i gshed: rta mgrin phur pa yang dag rbod gtong la: rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul: thugs rjes brtser dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛta kha raṃ khā hi: rig 'dzin drag sngags dregs 'dul bka' sdod tshogs: mkha' 'gro chos skyong gzhi gnas gter bdag la: rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul: thugs rjes brtser dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛta kha raṃ khā hi: mtheb srin sbyar bas bdud rtsi gnas gsum du reg cing lcer myangs la/ hūm̐: lce yi dam tshig rdo rje la: dam tshig can gyis hūm̐ bsgoms te: mtheb srin thabs shes phyag rgya yis: myangs na dngos grub mchog thob 'gyur: kā ya sid+dhi oṃ:

wā ka sid+dhi ā: tsit+ta sid+dhi hūm̐: sarba sid+dhi hrī: bcu bdun pa gtor mchod ni/ hūm̐: dam rdzas rmad byung gtor chen po: 'dod yon lnga yi phung por 'bar: thams cad tshim byed mchod sbyin che: zhi khro yongs rdzogs thugs dam bskang: ma hā ba liṃ ta khā hi: bco brgyad pa rak+ta ni/ hūm̐: ru dra bsgral ba'i khrag chen po: lcang lor bcas pa'i bhañdzar bskyil: 'khor ba dbyings su dag bya'i phyir: dpal chen tshogs kyi zhal du 'bul: ma hā rak+ta khā hi: bcu dgu pa bdud rtsi gsang nan ni/ hūm̐: rgyu gnyis rkyen sbyar 'bru bcud 'di: dug lnga sman sbyar dam pa'i rdzas: dza gad dpa' bo'i bdud rtsi 'dis: rgyal ba zhi khro'i thugs dam bskang: ma hā pañtsa a mṛta dza gad khā hi: nyi shu pa sbyor mchod ni/ hūm̐: dbyings rig gnyis med sbyor ba yis: 'khor 'das gnyis su med par sbyor: gnyis med rtogs pa'i sbyor mchod 'dis: rgyal ba yab yum mnyes gyur cig: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: pad+ma yo gi nī sa ma ya pra be sha ya phaṭa: nyer gcig pa sgrol mchod ni/ hūm̐: yang dag don rtogs blo yis ni: ma rtogs sems can gnas su bsgral: dus gsum bde gshegs de la mnyes: mchog gi mchod pa chen po bzhes: oṃ ma hā shrī he ru ka ma traṃ ru dra pra bhañdza tsakra hūm̐ phaṭa: pra be sha ya phaṭa: ti hūm̐ e yaṃ s+pha ra ṇa phaṭa: nyer gnyis pa bstod pa ni/ oṃ: mnyam nyid chos sku'i rang bzhin las: kun bzang zag pa med par bde: sems can don la de bzhin gshegs: thugs rje'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: ā: rtsol med rang byung chos sku'i sgra: ma 'gags rang gsal 'dzin pa med: chags med skyon bral pad+ma'i gsung: yang dag gsung la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: spros pa med pa dbyings kyi ngang: ma skyes 'jigs med rdo rje'i thugs: blang dor med pa chos kyi dbyings: 'gyur med thugs la phyag 'tshal bstod: swā: chos dbyings rol pa chen po las:

rtsal dang rol par mi dmigs kyang: nam mkha' mdzod kyi cho 'phrul gyis: yon tan re skong phyag 'tshal bstod: hā: rang bzhin cir yang ma nges kyang: dkyil 'khor chen po'i cha bzung nas: rtog med dregs pa ngang gis 'dul: phrin las mdzad la phyag 'tshal bstod: oṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā: na mo hri da ya: oṃ na ma: tshom bu dgu so sor bstod pa ni/ hūm̐: dus gsum bde gshegs chos rnams rdzogs pa'i dpal: zhi ba yongs rdzogs lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: dus gsum bde gshegs yon tan rdzogs pa'i dpal: che mchog yongs rdzogs lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: dus gsum bde gshegs thugs mchog rdzogs pa'i dpal: yang dag yongs rdzogs lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: dus gsum bde gshegs sku mchog rdzogs pa'i dpal: gshin rje yongs rdzogs lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: dus gsum bde gshegs gsung mchog rdzogs pa'i dpal: dbang chen yongs rdzogs lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: dus gsum bde gshegs phrin las rdzogs pa'i dpal: phur pa yongs rdzogs lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: dus gsum bde gshegs gzi brjid rdzogs pa'i dpal: ma mo yongs rdzogs lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: dus gsum bde gshegs phyag rgya rdzogs pa'i dpal: rig 'dzin yongs rdzogs lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: dus gsum bde gshegs mngon spyod rdzogs pa'i dpal: 'jig rten yongs rdzogs lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: dus gsum bde gshegs dmod mthu rdzogs pa'i dpal: drag sngags yongs rdzogs lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: phrin las bzhi bsgrub phyi nang bar chad sel: sgo ba sgo ma'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod: rgyal ba'i spyan sngar bstan pa'i gnyer blangs pa'i: bka' nyan srung ma'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'di bzhes la: bla med sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub rnams: bdag sogs mos pa'i bu la bstsal du gsol: don gyi bstod pa ni/ hūm̐: rnam dag ye shes thugs kyi dkyil 'khor du:

'gro don 'dod dgur bsgyur zhing gtso dang 'khor: ji ltar sprul kyang ye shes rig pa'i rtsal: rang shar rang grol bde gshegs g.yung drung lha: rnam dag chos kyi dbyings las ma g.yos pa'i: thams cad chos skur yongs rdzogs lha la bstod: ces bstod la sngar 1$0000250spros pa'i lha mo rnams rang la bsdu1$0000300 'o// nyer gsum pa bshags pa ni/ hūm̐: zhi khro bde gshegs yongs rdzogs dgongs: sngon nas rang dang mnyam nyid don: ma rtogs rigs mtshan so sor bzung: dbyer med rnam dag klong du bshags: sa ma ya e ho shud+dhe a: oṃ shrī badz+ra he ru ka sa ma ya: ma nu pā la ya: badz+ra he ru ka twe no pa tiṣ+ṭha: dṛ ḍho me bha ba: su toṣ+yo me bha ba: a nu rak+to me bha ba: su po ṣ+yo me bha ba: sarba sid+dhi m+me pra yats+tsha: sarba karma su tsa me tsit+taṃ shre yaḥku ru hūm̐ ha ha ha ha ho: bha ga wān: badz+ra he ru ka ma me muñtsa: he ru ko bha ba: ma hā sa ma ya satwa āḥhūm̐ phaṭa: nyer bzhi pa dzap bzla ba la gnyis/ zhi bar bsnyen pa/ khro bor sgrub pa'o// dang po ni/ dkyil 'khor gtso dgu'i lha rnams kyi dbu gtsug tu rigs bdag kun bzang yab yum/ spyi bor gnas lngar so so'i rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa bzhugs pa'i gnas gsum 'bru gsum dang thugs srog sa bon sngags phreng gis bskor ba/ lha thams cad kyi zhal nas sngags bzlas pas thugs rgyud bskul/ sngags phreng las 'od zer 'phros pas stong gsum thams cad zhi ba'i lha dang sngags sgras gang*/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas kyi byin rlabs tshur bsdus nas thim par gyur/

ces dmigs la dzap bskul ni/ hūm̐: gsang ba yongs rdzogs dkyil 'khor du: che mchog dpal dgu'i dbu rgyan nang: thabs shes nyi zla pad+ma'i steng: mi bskyod rnam par snang mdzad dang: rin 'byung snang mtha' don yod grub: yum chen kun bzang sangs rgyas spyan: mā ki gos dkar dam tshig sgrol: rgyal ba yab yum phyag mtshan bcas: kun bzang yab yum dgyes par sbyor: sras mchog sems dpa' sems mar bcas: sprul sku thub drug mthar byed brgyad: mnyen lcug 'khril ldem gzhon tshul can: gsal 'tsher lhun sdug gzi brjid 'bar: dbu rgyan cod pan phreng ba dang: do shal dpung rgyan se mo do: rin chen dar dpyang chas rnams rdzogs: gsung ni yang snying sngags sgra sgrog: thugs ni rang byung ye shes gsal: dzap kyis sku gsung thugs rgyud bskul: spros pas stong gsum sku yis gang: sku las gsung byon sngags 'brug ldir: bsdus pas chos dbyings mkha' la thim: ma gsal bar du bskyed cing bsgom: ma grub bar du mi gtang ngo: dam pa rigs brgya'i rtsa sngags ni/ oṃ ā li kā li dzñā na pañtsa satwa kro dha mu na ye swā hā: zhi ba zhe gnyis kyi rtsa sngags ni/ oṃ bo dhi tsit+ta ma hā su kha dzñā na dhā tu ā: rigs lnga yab yum gyi snying po ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā: māṃ lāṃ māṃ pāṃ tāṃ: zhes pa rnams so sor bzlas la/ stong tshigs 'bul ba 'gre /gnyis pa la gsum/ phra mo'i ting nge 'dzin yid la gsal bas rang gi gnas sbyong ba/ bzlas brjod bsnyen pa'i 'phro 'dus ye shes lha nye bar bsnyen pa/ gsang ba byang chub sems kyi 'phro 'dus dngos grub yum gyi mkhar bsdu ba'o// dang po ni/ thugs kar ye shes sems dpa' rdor sems dkar po'i rnam par bzhugs pa'i thugs rin po che zur brgyad pa'i nang du nyi ma'i gdan la ting 'dzin sems dpa' rdo rje sngon po'i lte bar hūm̐ mthing nag gi mtha' skor du sngags phreng gis bskor bar gyur/

ces gsal btab la bzla'o// gnyis pa ni/ bzlas pa'i rkyen gyis thugs ka'i sngags phreng gyen du byung*/ ljags steng āḥl bskor/ shangs bug g.yas nas yar brgyud spyi bo'i oṃ la bskor ba byas nas phyir byung ba shangs bug g.yon gyi sgor thon/ yum gyi shangs bug g.yas nas zhugs te thugs ka'i hūm̐ la bskor cing gsang ba'i pad+mor babs par gyur/ ces bzla/ gsum pa ni/ yum mkha'i sngags phreng las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas rgyal ba thams cad mchod/ thugs rje byin rlabs dngos grub thams cad bsdus nas yum gyi pad+mar bskyil ba de rdo rje'i lam brgyud thugs ka'i hūm̐ la thim par gyur/ ces mos/ de dag gi dzap bskul ni/ hūm̐: dbus phyogs 'khor lo'i gzhal yas su: zla gam dbang chen e dkyil du: byol song gtso brgyad dregs pa'i steng: thabs shes nyi zla 'od kyi dkyil: ma chags pad+ma'i ge sar la: bcom ldan che mchog he ru ka: yum chen gnam zhal dbyings phyug ma: gnyis med 'khril sbyor cha lugs ni: sgeg pa dpa' ba 'jigs su rung: rgod dang gshe dang snying rje rngam: 'bar khro zhi sogs gar dgur ldan: sku la dur khrod chas rnams rdzogs: gsung ni drag po'i sngags sgra sgrog: thugs ni sgrol mdzad srog dang bcas: dzap kyis sku gsung thugs rgyud bskul: phaṭa kyis spros pas stong gsum gang: bsdus pas yum gyi mkha' la 'khyil: gsang ba'i sbubs nas thugs kar thim: ma gsal bar du bskyed cing bsgom: ma grub bar du mi gtang ngo: zhes bskul/ bzla bya'i sngags ni gtso bo la/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha ma hā shrī he ru ka hūm̐ phaṭa: dpal brgyad la/ oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐: oṃ hrīḥṣ+ṭī bī kṛ tā na na hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ ha ya grī ba hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ gu h+ya dzñā na shrī he ru ka kro dhī shwa rī hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ badz+ra ma hā gu ru sarba sid+dhi hūm̐ phaṭa:

oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa sarba duṣ+ṭān hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ badz+ra sarba duṣ+ṭān e dza bh+yo hūm̐ phaṭa: khyung dang bka' sdod la/ hūm̐: yang sprul khyung chen bka' sdod tshogs: bzlas brjod bsnyen pa'i mchod pa bzhes: khrā+oṃ ga ru ḍa hūm̐ phaṭa: sarba ḍā ki nī sa ma ya hrīṃ hrīṃ hūm̐ phaṭa: ces gnam lcags kyi thog rgod ltar bzla/ lha tshogs bdun brgya nyer lnga'i zhal nas drag sngags 'brug sgra stong gsum gang bar bsgrags pas khams gsum chos nyid du bsgral/ ba spu'i bu ga tshun chad nas ye shes kyi me mgar gyi tshwa tshwa lta bur 'phros pas snang srid me phung gis gang*/ phyi sems can kun gyi las nyon phung po/ nang sgrub po'i rnam rtog 'khrul 'dzin/ bar gdon bgegs thams cad gzhob tu bsregs nas skye med dbyings su thim par gyur/ ces mos la/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā kro dha pad+ma kro dhī shwa rī badz+ra kī li kī la ya ma hā yak+sha kā la rū pa karma raṃ raṃ dz+wa la raṃ hūm̐ phaṭa: ces gnam lcags kyi thog rgod ltar bzla/ mthar stong tshigs mchod bstod ni/ hūm̐: ye shes lha tshogs spyan 'dren gshegs: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod tshogs 'bul: sku gsung thugs yon phrin las bstod: nyams chag 'gal 'khrul ci mchis bshags: oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā pañtsa ba liṃ ta rak+ta khā hi: bzlas pa thams cad grub nas gzhi bstod rgyas par bya bar bshad kyang spyi dril tsam ni/ hūm̐: bcom ldan bde gshegs kun bzang rigs lnga yab: gdug pa 'dul phyir khrag 'thung sku lngar ston: bzang mo la sogs kro dhī yum rnams 'khril: sems dpa' lcam dral mthar byed thub pa drug: dregs pa 'joms mdzad gtum rngam tshogs dang bcas: zhi khro yongs rdzogs lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: ces pa tsam bya'o// nyer lnga pa dngos grub blang ba ni/ las byang gi dkyus dang rgyun du mi dgos kyang grangs dus rtags kyi bsnyen pa rdzogs pa'i tshe/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas bla ma rig 'dzin yi dam rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor mkha' 'gro dam can rnams kyi thugs rgyud bskul/

byin rlabs dngos grub thams cad 'od zer kha dog lnga ldan gyi tshul du byon nas rang gi gnas gsum du thim par bsams la/ hūm̐: lha dang rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro dgongs: 'dir 'dus rig 'dzin bdag cag rnams: smin grol gnyis kyis rgyud sbyangs shing: bskyed rdzogs gnyis kyis las gzhung bsrangs: bsnyen sgrub rnam gsum mtha' ru phyin: las dang thugs rje mthun pa yi: zhi rgyas dbang drag yid bzhin gter: sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ kā ya wā ka tsit+ta sid+dhi hūm̐ āḥ zhes pa rnams kyis dngos gzhi grub/ rjes kyi las khrigs bcu gcig tu gsungs pa las/ dang po tshogs mchod ni/ zhing lpags kyi khar thabs shes kyi bza' btung gtso bor gyur pa'i yo byad bsags/ chu chang nang gsum gyis sbyangs te byin gyis brlab pa ni/ oṃ uts+tshush+ma pai tā li kro dha nī sarba dra byaṃ saṃ sho dha ni hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā: hūm̐: rdo rje lta bu'i ye shes kyis: chos kun thams cad sgyu mar rig: rig pa'i ye shes raṃ yaṃ khaṃ: tshogs kyi dngos po bsreg sbyang bkru: raṃ yaṃ khaṃ: tshogs kyi yo byad stong pa'i ngang: a dang ma las nyi zla yi: snod du 'bru gsum zhu ba las: 'dod yon lnga ldan phung por gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐: tshogs zhing spyan 'dren pa ni/ hūm̐: rgyal ba zhi khro'i lha tshogs rnams: ye shes rol pa'i tshogs la gshegs: dam tshig dkyil 'khor gnas 'dir bzhugs: bdag dad gus pas phyag 'tshal lo: hūm̐: gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya chos: mdzes snyan dri zhim ro bda' zhing: reg bde glu gar chos yid tshim: 'dod yon mchod pas thugs dam bskang: de nas tshogs kyi bskang ba'i yul snyan gsan dbab pa ni/ hūm̐: zhi khro rgyal ba yongs rdzogs lha: 'gro la phan mdzad thugs rje'i bdag: sems can kun gyi gnyen gcig pu: kun nas bdag la dgongs su gsol: zhes brjod pas 1$0000250chos sku las gzugs skur bzhengs par 1$0000300

bsams la thog mar nyams chag bshags pa ni/ hūm̐: shar nas badz+ra ak+ṣo bh+ya: rdo rje rigs kyi thugs dam las: zhe sdang dam tshig nyams so 'tshal: 'di yang mi 'chab mthol lo bshags: hūm̐: lho nas rat+na saṃ bha trāṃ: rin chen rigs kyi thugs dam las: nga rgyal dam tshig nyams so 'tshal: 'di yang mi 'chab mthol lo bshags: hūm̐: nub nas pad+ma dhe ba hrī: pad+ma rigs kyi thugs dam las: 'dod chags dam tshig nyams so 'tshal: 'di yang mi 'chab mthol lo bshags: hūm̐: byang nas a mo gha sid+dhi: las kyi rigs kyi thugs dam las: phrag dog dam tshig nyams so 'tshal: 'di yang mi 'chab mthol lo bshags: hūm̐: dbus nas bai ro tsa na bzhugs: de bzhin rigs kyi thugs dam las: gti mug dam tshig nyams so 'tshal: 'di yang mi 'chab mthol lo bshags: de nas skong ba ni mchod rdzas thogs te dkyil 'khor bskor la/ hūm̐: bskang ngo bskal pa'i bar du thugs dam bskang: bskang ba med de khams gsum yongs kyis bskang: sbyor ba med de khams gsum yongs kyis sbyor: sgrol ba med de khams gsum yongs kyis sgrol: ye sbyor ye sgrol chen pos thugs dam bskang: thugs dam gnyan po skong ba'i dam rdzas ni: rtsa brgyad stong las sbyar ba'i bdud rtsi dang: khyad par rmad du byung ba'i gtor ma dang: 'khor ba rgyu las bsgral ba'i rak+ta dang: rnam dag rgyu bsgral bam chen rdzas mchog dang: 'bru bcud stong las sbyar ba'i dza gad dang: phyi nang gsang ba'i longs spyod sna tshogs kyis: bka' brgyud bla ma rnams kyi thugs dam bskang: zhi ba lhun gyis grub pa'i dkyil 'khor nas: bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis rgyal ba'i thugs= khro bo rol pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po nas: che mchog yon tan lha tshogs thugs= khrag 'thung rol pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po nas: yang dag thugs kyi lha tshogs thugs= gshin rje rol pa'i dur khrod chen po nas: 'jam dpal sku yi lha tshogs thugs= dbang chen rol pa'i dur khrod chen po nas:

pad+ma gsung gi lha tshogs thugs= phur pa rol pa'i dur khrod chen po nas: phur pa phrin las lha tshogs thugs= sha khrag rgya mtshor 'khyil ba'i dkyil 'khor nas: ma mo rbod gtong lha tshogs thugs= thugs rje gdung 'tshob sku yi dkyil 'khor nas: rig 'dzin bla ma'i lha tshogs thugs= dug lnga me ltar 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas: 'jig rten mchod bstod lha tshogs thugs= gtum drag me ltar 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas: dmod pa drag sngags lha tshogs thugs= dkyil 'khor dgu yi bar khyams khor yug nas: bka' srung dam can rgya mtsho'i thugs= zhing chen gcal du bkram pa'i dkyil 'khor nas: pho nya las byed tshogs kyi thugs= sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung bar zhal bzhes pa'i: sngags bdag sde dpon sum cu'i thugs= pho rgyud mgon po'i tshogs kyi thugs dam bskang: mo rgyud lha mo'i tshogs kyi thugs= gnod sbyin nor lha'i tshogs kyi thugs= drang srong gza' yi tshogs kyi thugs= dam can dpe srog gtsang gsum thugs= yul lha gzhi bdag rnams kyi thugs dam bskang: zhes mtshan don bye brag tu bskang*/ hūm̐: dur khrod gsang ba mchog gi dkyil 'khor 'dir: gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor gzhung bzhin bkod nas kyang: bsgrub rdzas gnyan po tshul ltar bkram lags na: rgyal ba zhi khro'i thugs dam gnyan bskangs te: rnal 'byor bdag la g.yar dam sor stsol cig: oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐: zhes dang yig brgya brjod/ skabs 'dir sger srung ma ning*/ dregs pa'i sde dpon/ mkha' ri bsnyo kha rnams kyi gtor 'bul gyi phyag len snang ngo*// de nas tshogs phud rim pa gsum spros pa'i dang po phud mchod ni/ hūm̐: bla med mchog gi mchod sbyar bas: ye shes lnga yi 'od zer 'phro: 'dod yon lha mos rab brgyan 'bul: dam skong dbang dang dngos grub stsol: oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥsarba thā khaṃ ut+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ swā hā:

lan gsum/ bar pa bshags pa ni/ hūm̐: ma rig bdag cag lus ngag sems: bag med dam 'gal 'byor tshogs chung: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro yi: thugs dang 'gal gyur bzod par gsol: a ho ma hā su kha sa ma ya ho: tha ma bsgral ba'i thog mar gzhung gi rtsis mgo gnyis pa che ba bskyed pa ni/ hūm̐: snang srid thams cad gzhal yas khang: gzugs snang thams cad he ru ka: thams cad thams cad bran du khol: nga las che ba su yang med: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: gsum pa phrin las bskul ba ni/ hūm̐: chos sku skye med ngang nyid las: gzugs sku 'jigs pa'i cha lugs bzhengs: zhi rgyas dbang dang mngon spyod las: bcol ba'i phrin las sgrub par mdzod: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: badz+ra sarba duṣ+ṭān: oṃ shān+tiṃ: swā puṣ+ṭiṃ: āḥwa shaṃ: hā mā ra ya phaṭa: sarba sid+dhi ku ru hūm̐: rbod zor sarba zlog bh+yo: dmigs bya'i gzugs rten la 'gugs gzhug ni/ na mo/ sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ chos kyi bka'= dge 'dun gyi bka'= rgyal ba zhi khro'i lha tshogs rnams kyi bka'= bka' srung pho nya las mkhan rnams kyi bka'= gzhan yang gsang sngags dang rig sngags dang gzungs sngags dang/ snying po dang*/ phyag rgya dang*/ sngags 'chang bdag gi sngags dang phyag rgya ting nge 'dzin gyi bden pa'i stobs kyis bdag cag rnal 'byor pa dpon slob yon mchod dgon sde grwa tshan 'khor dang bcas pa la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i gzugs can gyi dgra /gzugs med kyi bgegs/ khyad par du byad ma rbod gtong lha dang bcas pa rnams/ mgon byed kyi lha'am/ tshe dang dbang thang ngam bsod nams dang dus kyi dbang du ma btang bar/ da lta nyid du liṅga 'di la khug cig / drag sngags so lnga pa'i sham bur/ nṛ tri hur thum dza: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: ā be sha ya a ā: lan gsum gyis bkug la phur thun bskul ba ni/ hūm̐: chos kyi dbyings nas rang byung grub pa'i lha: khro bo rol pa'i dur khrod chen po nas:

shin tu mi bzad rab 'jigs skur ston pa: dpal chen yongs rdzogs drag po'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: nga ni dpal chen he ru ka: sras 'khor sprul pa bye ba 'bum: bka' sdod rab 'jigs pho nyar bcas: bka' brgyad lha tshogs dus la babs: g.yas kyi phyag na phur pa 'dril: g.yon gyi phyag na lcags kyus 'gugs: lcags kyus zungs la phur pas thob: gnod byed dgra bgegs rdul du rlogs: drag sngags so lnga pa'i gsham du/ dgra bgegs gnod byed 'byung po thams cad mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa: ces brjod de tshe lung khrus lung gi dgongs pas phur pa gdab cing bsgral pa'i sha khrag bdud rtsir spar ba bstab pa ni/ hūm̐: dpal chen khrag 'thung lha tshogs zhal phye zhig: bag chags kun sbyong 'khor ba'i lam dgag phyir: dgra bgegs bsgral pa'i dug gsum sha khrag rus: za byed mi 'gyur chos nyid klong du rol: badz+ra yak+ṣa kro dha bi dza ya khā hi: de nas las rdor gyis tshogs rdzas btegs la/ ho: zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa 'di: 'dod yon ma spangs longs spyod rgyan: dngos grub sna tshogs 'di las 'byung: rnal 'byor dgyes par tshogs la rol: sid+dhi pha la a la la ho:

zhes slob dpon nas brtsam ste 'dus pa rnams la drang*/ nang gi sreg blugs dang ldan pas rol pa'i mthar/ smon lam ni/ hūm̐: sngon nas da lta yan chad du: rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas rnams: bsod nams dge ba'i tshogs 'khor gyis: tshe dbang longs spyod brtan rgyas shog: ces sogs gdab/ bzhi pa lhag chog la thog mar gtsang lhag yar gnas la 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: chos dbyings skye med rnam dag las: skye ba'i cho 'phrul zhi khro'i tshogs: 'dir spyon rgyan gyi mchod gtor bzhes: sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsol: ces gtsang lhag dang bdud rtsi gsang nan snod zur du bkod na lhan cig nam mkhar 'bul/ dme gtor la gtsang phud kyi ras ma btab/ de la slob dpon gyis dam tshig gi kha phru btab pa sogs phyag len ma nor bar byas la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ pañtsa a mṛta hūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥ lhag ma'i dam tshig 'dod yon gyi phung po zad mi shes pas nam mkha' gang bar gyur/ e ā ral+li hriṃ hriṃ dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe nas shab+da pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ zhes brlab cing mgron bkug ste mchod la/ hūm̐: dang po phud kyis mi mchod du: bka' brgyad yongs rdzogs lha rnams gnyan: bar du lhag mas mi mchod du: ma dang mkha' 'gro lhag la dgyes: tha ma gcig tu mi bsre ru: chos nyid ye nas rgyu 'bras gcig: hūm̐: dpal gyi bka' nyan lhag sdud ma: rigs bzhi mkha' 'gro shugs 'gror bcas: dbang phyug chen mo nyer brgyad dang: mkha' 'gro sum cu rtsa gnyis dang: skyes mchog ging chen bco brgyad po: ma bdun sring bzhi 'bar ma brgyad: pho nya drug cu rtsa bzhi'i tshogs: laṅka dur khrod bdag mo dang: 'bum phrag yangs pa'i mkha' 'gro ma: lha srin sde brgyad thams cad kyang: dam tshig bsrung zhing mkha' la 'gro: zas su sha dang khrag la dgyes: las su gsod dang gcod la brtson: sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la: sngon tshe dpal gyi bka' bzhin du: bcol pa'i phrin las sgrub par mdzod:

oṃ ma hā shrī he ru ka sa ma ya de bī kro dha sarba ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi: oṃ āḥhūm̐ uts+tshiṣ+ṭa badz+ra a dhiṣ+ṭha sa mu dra krā ma sa ma ya hūm̐ phaṭa: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: hrī hrī hrī: bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo: a ra li dza: zhes sgrub khang gi lho nub tu bskyal lo// skabs 'dir spyi lugs ltar thugs dam bskul ba mdor bsdus ni/ hūm̐: mi mngon dbyings na bzhugs pa rgyal ba zhi khro'i tshogs: ā: bzhengs shig bzhengs shig chos kyi dbyings nas bzhengs: hūm̐: bskul lo bskul lo sems can don la bskul: hrī: mdzod cig mdzod cig bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod: ā: chos sku skye ba med pa'i ngang nyid las: oṃ: skye ba'i cho 'phrul longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku: hūm̐: sprul skus 'gro ba sems can don mdzad pa: hrī: zhi khro bka' brgyad lha tshogs thugs dam can: oṃ: gzugs snang thams cad sku yi rang bzhin la: ā: sgra grags thams cad gsung gi ngo bor snang: hūm̐: dran rtog thams cad thugs kyi dgongs par 'dus: hrī: phyogs bcu dus bzhi'i bde gshegs bcom ldan 'das: sgrub pa bka' brgyad dpal gyi bka' sdod bcas: mi mngon dbyings nas gnas 'dir sku skyod cig: dam rdzas bdud rtsi 'bar ba 'di bzhes la: thugs dam rgyud bskul bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod: lnga pa gtor skyong ni/ hūm̐ bh+yo: sngon tshe 'das dus bskal pa dang po la: 'og min dga' ldan gnas mchog dam pa ru: bcom ldan dpal chen khrag 'thung chen po yis: snang srid ma mo dam la btags pa'i tshe: gau ri la sogs gnas kyi ma mo brgyad: siṃ ha la sogs yul gyi phra men brgyad: rta gdong la sogs ye shes sgo ma bzhi: so so'i gzugs mchog dam pa bstan nas kyang: ji ltar zhal bzhes dam las ma g.yel bar: mchod gtor 'di bzhes bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod: de 'og bar gyi bskal pa dbus ma la: bal yul yang le shod kyi dben gnas su: slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas dang:

slob ma mkhas pa bi ma mi tra yis: rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor zhal phye tshe: rdo rje rigs kyi srung ma yongs 'dus nas: so so'i gzugs mchog dam pa bstan nas kyang: ji ltar zhal bzhes dam las ma g.yel bar: mchod gtor 'di bzhes bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod: de 'og bskal pa dus kyi tha ma la: bsam yas lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag tu: slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas dang: slob ma'i dwangs ma rje 'bangs grogs gsum gyis: zhi khro yongs rdzogs dkyil 'khor zhal phye tshe: sgrub pa bka' brgyad dam can yongs 'dus nas: so so'i gzugs mchog dam pa bstan nas kyang: ji ltar zhal bzhes dam las ma g.yel bar: mchod gtor 'di bzhes bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod: de 'og lnga brgya dus kyi snyigs ma la: dpal ri pad+ma 'od kyi gzhal yas su: slob dpon chen po pad+ma thod phreng dang: thugs rje chen po'i rnal 'byor chos dbang gis: gsang ba sgrub chen dkyil 'khor zhal phye tshe: dregs pa'i sde dpon chen po sum cu yis: so so'i gzugs mchog dam pa bstan nas kyang: ji ltar zhal bzhes dam las ma g.yel bar: mchod gtor 'di bzhes bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod: drug pa gtor zor ni/ hūm̐: ma nyes dpang du dkon mchog bzhugs: dgra bgegs ma gtogs sku zur cig: bka' brgyad lha tshogs dmag dpung skyed: dgra bgegs snying la gtor zor rgyob: badz+ra sarba duṣ+ṭān trig nan: e hur thuṃ dza: dgra bgegs nṛ tri sha truṃ mā ra ya rbad: bdun pa brtan ma skyong ba ni/ gtor ma 'bru gsum gyis bdud rtsir brlabs la/ hūm̐: bstan pa skyong mdzad ma dang sring: dpal gnas ma dang yang dag shes: khyung btsun kong lha g.yu bun ma: me tog zla 'od byang rgyal ma: gser thang kun bzang shān+tiṃ dpal: klu mo gzi 'bar la sogs pa'i: brtan ma bcu gnyis gtor ma longs: mi mthun gnod pa'i phyogs rnams zlog: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra a mṛta khā hi:

ma ma hriṃ ma ma hriṃ khā hi khā hi: brgyad pa gtor bro ni/ mdun du e sgrom 'bar ba'i nang du dgra bgegs bcug pa'i steng nas gtor gzhong ri rab tu gyur pas mnan pa la khro bo rol pa'i bros gzir bar bsams la/ rgyas par spro na gzhung ltar las bzhi'i bro brdung*/ mdor bsdu na/ hūm̐: zhi khro bka' brgyad rol pa'i bro: dgra bgegs dam sri'i steng du brdung: g.yas su bskor te dgra la brdung: dgra yang phye mar 'thag pa'i bro: g.yon du bskor te bgegs la brdung: bgegs kyang dum bur gtub pa'i bro: g.yas g.yon thabs dang shes rab bro: ru dra dam sri thal bar rlog: oṃ laṃ hūm̐ laṃ s+t+waṃ bha ya nan: oṃ sum+bha ni sogs hūm̐ bzhi'i sngags brjod/ kha cig gis skabs 'dir tshe 'gugs mdzad pa ltar na rigs mthun nas len/ dngos grub bskul ba gong gi de'am sgrub khog ltar na/ hūm̐: bde gshegs rgyal ba kun gyi thugs dam dang: sbyor lam tshogs lam gnas pa'i dam can tshogs: rnal 'byor bdag la sngon gyi thugs dam gyis: tshe dbang chos dang las bzhi lhun 'grub dang: rkang mgyogs mig sman ril bu mkha' spyod dang: srid nor zas gos mthu rtsal dngos grub stsol: a la la ho: hūm̐: chos sku mchog las kun 'byung longs spyod rdzogs: 'gro don lhun grub sprul sku gcig gi ngang: ma bcos gnyis med sku gsum lhun gyis rdzogs: mchog gi dngos grub bdag la bstsal du gsol: ces bdud rtsi sogs dngos grub kyi rdzas la longs spyod/ gtang rag gi don du sngags tsam gyis mchod/ bstod pa mdor bsdus bya/ dgu pa nongs pa bzod par gsol zhing lhag chad kha skong ba ni/ yi ge brgya pa mang du brjod/ ma rnyed yongs su ma tshang sogs dang dbyangs gsal lan gsum bzla'o// bcu pa dkyil 'khor bsdu ba ni/ hūm̐: dang po chos sku skye med ngang nyid las: 'gro don skye ba'i cho 'phrul tshom bu dgu: zhi khro yongs rdzogs 'gro ba kun btul nas:

slar yang chos dbyings rnam dag klong du bsdu: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra mu: rgyun spyod ni/ hūm̐: ngar 'dzin rnam dag sgyu lus 'ja' 'dra 'di: dpal chen sku gsung thugs kyi rgyas btab ste: bden pa dbyer med lta spyod zung 'brel bas: rgyun du 'gro ba 'dren pa'i spyod lam bya'o: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra hri: bcu gcig pa smon lam dang shis brjod ni/ hoḥ bsod nams ye shes tshogs gnyis mthu byin gyis: bdag gzhan 'gro ba ma lus thams cad kun: zhi rgyas dbang drag phrin las mnga' brnyes shing: sku gsum lhun grub 'gro don mthar phyin shog: me tog 'thor la/ khyab bdag kun tu bzang dang rdo rje sems// dga' rab shrī siṃ o rgyan yab yum dang*// chos kyi dbang phyug yab sras brgyud par bcas// rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams kyi bkra shis shog /chos sku mi 'gyur kun tu bzang po'i klong*// longs sku rigs lnga sku lnga ye shes lnga// sprul sku sna tshogs 'gro don yid bzhin gter// bde gshegs zhi ba'i lha tshogs bkra shis shog /chos dbyings rnam dag ngang las ma g.yos kyang*// thabs kyis khro bo'i skur ston gdug pa 'dul// che ba'i che mchog lha yi lhar gyur pa// sgrub chen bka' brgyad lha yi bkra shis shog /thos bsam sgom pa mthar phyin bla ma mchog /dngos grub kun stsol yi dam yongs rdzogs lha// bar chad sel mdzad mkha' 'gro chos skyong tshogs// bkra shis des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog / ces brjod par bya'o// gsang ba yongs rdzogs kyi las byang gter gzhung rigs lnga'i rgya can la rang gzhung nas kha skong dgos rigs chos bdag sman lung pa'i phyag bzhes sangs rgyas dwags ston yab sras kyi rgyun las byung ba rtse le dang lnga pa'i gsung rnams tshad thub tu bzhugs kyang*/ cung zad mang bas 'dir khyer bde snying por bzung ste bkod pa'o// yo ga rnam gsum zab rgyas gsang ba kun// yongs rdzogs snying khrag dang mtshungs sgrub chen 'di// srid pa ji srid dbyar gyi mtsho ltar 'phel// sngags bstan nub pa med pa'i btsas gyur cig
